name: array_dish
notes: One of the eleven Saltmirror Array dishes: a 100 m bowl on a leaning four-legged pedestal that rises 20 m to the turntable, with a quadripod holding the feed cabin 80 m up. Stairs on the back (local +Z) climb in flights to a bridge, a ladder goes up the drum to the turntable and on up the west arm; an equipment hut on the pad has a 1 m by 2.25 m doorway on its east side. Faces zenith; carves nothing.
